_comment: GIST1M HNSWMerger C++ sweep. PREREQUISITES: (1) apply the GIST workload patch and recompile -- python scripts/patch_hnswmerger_gist.py /path/to/HNSW-Merger && (cd /path/to/HNSW-Merger && make build && make exp); (2) fetch GIST -- scripts/get_data.sh --gist. dim=960, nq=1000. NOTE: GIST is ~7.5x SIFT's dimension, so a full {2,4,8} sweep is a multi-hour job -- confirm with the advisor whether full-scale wall-clock is needed or a subset suffices before running everything.
